name: tiktok-live-game-platform
description: A TikTok LIVE game platform hosting one hundred independent games - including TEAM ARENA with seventy-five team, word-duel and arcade formats, HANGMAN LIVE and sixty-six more interactive chat games where every viewer answers on their own (word, language-learning, maths, geography, quiz, estimation and visual puzzles) - behind one game-selector screen, each reading real audience chat. Word games can be played in English, Bahasa Indonesia, Bahasa Melayu (Malaysia) or any mix.
